name: Adib Hassan
intro: I’m an Electrical and Electronic Engineering researcher passionate about photonic biosensors, nanotechnology, metamaterials and innovative engineering solutions.
about:
I have completed my B.Sc. in Electrical and Electronic Engineering (EEE) from Rajshahi University of Engineering & Technology (RUET), Bangladesh. My research interests include photonics, metamaterials, and biomedical sensing, particularly the design and optimization of high-sensitivity Surface Plasmon Resonance (SPR) biosensors for infectious disease detection using MATLAB, COMSOL Multiphysics, Transfer Matrix Method (TMM), and Finite Element Method (FEM). My broader academic interests include nanophotonics, optical sensing systems, computational electromagnetics, and interdisciplinary biomedical engineering applications. I am particularly motivated by research that bridges fundamental science with practical healthcare solutions, aiming to contribute to the development of affordable and efficient diagnostic technologies.

Alongside my research, I have held leadership roles as Chair of the IEEE RUET Student Branch, Vice Chair of RUET CORE, Vice Chair of the IEEE Computer Society Bangladesh Chapter’s Secretariat Executive Committee,  Director (Event Management) of Hult Prize at RUET, and Joint Secretary of Notre Dame College Association of RUET.

I’m now looking to pursue an MSc or PhD degree in a research-intensive environment, advancing optical biosensing and biomedical diagnostics. I am particularly interested in fully funded graduate opportunities with Graduate Research Assistantships (GRA) or Teaching Assistantships (TA) to further deepen my research knowledge and contribute to impactful innovations.
